The extent of adverse impacts on recreational resources caused by construction of this alternative are not known to the FPC Staff. Operation of this alternative reservoir would have impacts upon recreation at Lake Jocassee similar to those resulting from the proposed Bad Creek Project, as described in Subsection 3.2.1.
